rules.title: Tool name must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$
rules.rationale: The tool name must match the regex ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$.

rules.title: No oneOf/allOf/anyOf at the top level of input_schema
rules.rationale: The API returns 400 'input_schema does not support oneOf, allOf, or anyOf at the top level'. This is not stated in Anthropic's docs; the source is the API error text reproduced in public issues, so the rule is unverified. The rewrite drops the top-level combinator, which loosens validation.
